name: mirage
text: No. The app and the engine read only the Vigilant subaccount's ledger, because the keys are made for that subaccount. Bets you place by hand in the Novig app from your main account don't appear in it, and I haven't tested whether Novig's API can show them. That could explain part of a gap against Novig's own history. If you want, tell me the all-time figure Novig's app shows for the Vigilant subaccount, and I'll compare it with the Tracker's.
